Ultimately, Casa Amor is used as a test for the couples to test their current couples. This season is a little different from what I've seen. Usually what they do is separate the guys from the girls, put them in separate houses (exactly how it's set up now) with new boys and new girls. What's happened on past seasons is - they get to explore while separated from their couple if they want to really. The get to build connections if they want to. Then after a few days of being separated from their original partner - they then have the option to bring in a new guy/girl into the OG house, leaving their partner single if they weren't able to find a new connection.
